Update Krugersdorp Killers

By: Sinethemba Nogude | Production

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
The final chapter to the Krugerdorp Killers saga

Unique Selling Point:
We look at the sentencing of the remaining Krugersdorp killers; Marcel, Zack and Cecilia. The update will focus on Cecilia and how she spun her web of lies and managed to manipulate the other members of the Electus Pardeus into killing in the name of God.
We speak to the detective who took down this murderous group, as well as the lead prosecutor in the case that followed.
We will have access to t the proceedings and will film the judgment.

Script:


Upsound Judge Francis: This is the worst case I have presided over in my 18 years on the bench.
V/O: Chilling words from South Gauteng high court judge Ellem Francis as he sentenced the last “Krugersdorp Killers” – Cecilia Steyn, Zack Valentine and Marcel Steyn – to multiple life sentences, for murdering eleven people this week.
Upsound: Count 1…life imprisonment 16, count …life imprisonment.
V/O: Cecilia Steyn – the mastermind behind all the killings – was handed 13 life sentences plus 155 years, Zak Valentine 8 life sentences, plus 93 years. Finally, Marcel Steyn received 7 life sentences plus 144 years.
V/O: This comes after the trio was found guilty of 32 counts between them in June, including murder, fraud, racketeering and robbery.
V/O: Calling themselves Electus Per Deus, or chosen by God, the group included convicted murderers Marinda Steyn, her son Leroux Steyn, and John Barnard who were sentenced in 2018. Operating in and around Krugersdorp between 2012 and 2016, the group went on a senseless killing spree motivated by greed, revenge and religious extremism – all at the behest of kingpin -Cecilia Steyn.
Upsound Judge Francis: O9:54 It’s almost like the Krugersdorp area and the surrounds were struck by a man-made tsunami // the driving force of this tsunami was accused number two// Cecilia Steyn.
V/O: The bizarre trial featured testimonies of vampires, werewolves and witches ,and shocking evidence of how Cecilia manipulated and spun her web of lies, convincing members of the group to kill in the name of God.
Krugersdorp killers finale Marcel: She said that David killed a lot of people. And she said that God had instructed her that this is what we must do.
V/O: Captain Ben Booysen brought the group to book in 2016 – he understands the power that Cecelia wielded over the group all too well.
Unsound new footage. She manipulated them at such a high level that Zack went to kill his own wife.
V/O: Such was her cunning that Lead Prosecutor Advocate Gerrie Roberts, had to exhaust every legal avenue to bring her to justice.
Upsound Captain Booysen 09:27 Because of Cecilia only giving instructions, she didn’t dirty her hands, in our country it’s very difficult to find people guilty in such a manner.
V/O: So they used the Prevention Of Organised Crime Act, which allows the leader of a gang to be charged with racketeering. Even though Cecilia as the leader was not present during the murders, the members acted in common purpose with her.
V/O: But despite Cecilia being in prison with a slim chance of parole, Captain Booysen and Advocate Roberts still have sleepless nights.
Upsound Advocate Roberts New footage : My only concern is people who are going to be with her in jail that need to come out, what is she going to teach them…she will send psychopaths out to kill people
Upsound Captain Booysen New footage: Because even now in jail, she is portrayed as this good prisoner and it is just by deceit and lies…
